source_evidence: past performance does not predict future returns. But past performance can tell you how volatile or stable a fund has been over a period of time. The more volatile the fund, the higher the investment risk.
answer: A mutual fund’s past performance does not tell you what its future returns will be. It can, however, show how much the fund’s value has varied over a period of time. A fund that has been more volatile has had higher investment risk. Remember, mutual funds carry some risk, and you may lose some or all of the money you invest.
